basics.name: Shun-Hsiang Hsu
basics.label: Ph.D. Student at UIUC
basics.summary: Machine learning research in multimodal learning, computer vision, geometry-grounded synthetic data, and LLM evaluation. Experience in controlled experiments, benchmarking, model adaptation, and research prototypes.

work.name: Google
work.summary: Summer 2026 · LLM evaluation and skill-based agent systems.
highlights: Designed controlled experiments and refined scoring rubrics for an LLM autorater, achieving over 90% repeated-evaluation score consistency and over 90% alignment with human ratings.
Designed a graph representation of agent skills to encode sequencing and dependencies for relationship-aware retrieval, orchestration, and skill-library health checks.

work.name: Reconstruct Inc.
work.summary: Computer vision and 3D method evaluation, model adaptation, and training iteration.
highlights: Built controlled image-matching and 3D reconstruction benchmarks under low-texture, repeated-pattern, sparse-view, and illumination-shift conditions to guide production method selection.
Integrated FiLM-conditioned camera-orientation cues into a Swin Transformer segmentation model and trained inspection models through an internal active-learning pipeline.

work.name: TryTech Co., Ltd.
work.summary: LLM applications, human-AI workflows, and industry prototypes.
highlights: Built a customer-support LLM backend prototype with retrieval, tool orchestration, transaction workflows, and human handoff.
Prototyped inspection applications with iOS and web interfaces and deployed machine-learning and custom algorithm modules on AWS using SAM and Lambda for industry pilots.

work.name: NCREE–NTUCE Joint AI Research Center
highlights: Led six industry research projects developing and deploying deep-learning inspection systems for concrete and steel structures, integrating visual recognition into field inspection and near-real-time reporting.
